pilot_real_spec.title: Limited Real-Model 3-Arm Pilot Specification
blockers: Live Docker executor in `run_simple.py` creates a plain bridge network without `--internal` and `egress_proxy.py`.
Live `run_simple.py` CLI only accepts 2 modes (`without-mcp`, `with-mcp`) and must be invoked through the Stage 2.5 3-arm adapter or updated to wire Arm C.
Paid model execution requires explicit human owner spend authorization.
pilot_real_spec.token_measurement_limitations: Only 1 of 103 historical runs (0.97%) recorded observed API token usage (`usage.status == 'observed'`). Missing token counts must remain explicitly `unavailable` (`null`), never coerced to zero.

estimated_cost_formula.formula: Total_Cost_USD = sum_{i=1..N_sessions} (input_tokens_i * P_in_per_token + cached_input_tokens_i * P_cache_per_token + output_tokens_i * P_out_per_token), where N_sessions = 3 * K * R * (1 + r_infra). Monetary values are intentionally null until official `gpt-6-luna` API unit prices and spend authorization are supplied.

confirmatory_spec.title: Preregistered Confirmatory 3-Arm Experiment Specification
blockers: Confirmatory eligibility requires >= 30 tasks in `S1_confirmatory_core`; currently 0 tasks qualify.
Live container network isolation (`--internal` + `egress_proxy.py`) must be verified end-to-end before confirmatory trials.
Preregistration commit hash must be frozen on Git before deriving the confirmatory randomization seed.
Paid model execution requires explicit human owner spend authorization.

task_graduation_backlog.required_action: Run >= 3 baseline-only (Arm A) calibration trials per task under the pinned runtime image. Tasks with observed Arm A mean score in [0.10, 0.90] graduate directly to `S1_confirmatory_core` without inspecting Arm B/C outcomes.

For ceiling-saturated tasks (`C01`, `C02`, `C05`), harden edge-case requirements in a new task version. For `D01`–`D03` and `E04`–`E05` (`BEN-002`), decouple the scorer from narrow frozen package lists / extra-claim abstentions in a `knowledge-pilot-v2.2` revision, then re-screen on Arm A.

For `B01`–`B03` and `E02`–`E03`, execute Arm-A-only verification with the R container scorer (fixing historical `unsupported_for_automatic_scoring` runs) and harden difficulty if Arm A saturates at 1.0. For `E01`, resolve `BEN-002` extra-package abstention in `v2.2`.
